items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Lowey Warner was a good trombone.

ctx.x: One other question. Who were the best trombone players you remember when you were starting in music? The real all-limers.

Well, I can't think of this fella's name. Used to play with the Imperial Brass Band. He was a good trombone player. Lowey Warner was a good trombone. He had... This fella, he was alright too, but he didn't... He was a good improviser. He didn't read no music or... I see how they call him. He was a great big fella man. He was good too.
